en: What the hell are you doing?!
By morning, you won't remember any of this...
Forgive me.
Rosso.

en: If that is your wish,
I will spare no effort to help you...
I hear the citizens riot in the streets at night.
As mayor, I must do something about this.
If that is your wish,
I will use my authority however you see fit.
I hear the citizens are rioting at night.
Truth be told, as night draws near, I too
feel a strange ache stirring in my body.
I am Kröger, the mayor.

en: Sorry, but I'm in a hurry, so I'll be going.
Once again I have a mountain of work
to get through today, you see.
If you have any important business,
come see me at City Hall in person.
You don't know where City Hall is?
<Tell me>
<No, thanks>
Yes. Would you tell me the way?
From the central square of Calstatt,
go south and you'll find it.
The road runs straight, so you can't miss it.
No, that's all right. Thank you.
Please take good care of my son.
I beg you, make my son himself again...
I am Kröger, the mayor.
Sorry, but I'm tired today.
If you have business with me, come straight
to City Hall tomorrow...
Sorry, but I'm tired today, so
if you'll excuse me...
Please, make my son himself again...
I'm afraid my son won't listen to anyone
but you...
I value direct contact
with the citizens.
So whenever I have the time, I make a point
of meeting citizens who come to see me.
Now then, without further ado,
what is your business with me?
<I'd like you to find me a job>
<Tell me about yourself>
Hmm. Lately the unemployment rate
in this town does seem to be rising.
From the look of you, you seem intelligent,
and your manners are elegant.
I have an only son, and I'd like you
to be his private tutor.
Please call at my house at once.
You're an odd one

My son Ludwig has gone bad.

time with him. Perhaps that's the cause...

I'm surprised you actually
came to see me.

and I'd like to have you be his private
